about: Fictional demo data: Wren, a ranger-for-hire in the town of Ashvale. Dates are shifted by scripts/seed-demo.mjs so the last day lands on today.

activities.name: Patrol Run
activities.description: A run along the town wall or the forest trail on patrol duty.
activities.note: Goal: finish the Wall Warden patrol badge.

activities.name: Barracks Sparring
activities.description: Weapon drills or sparring at the barracks yard. Not the same as Stretching Kata.
activities.note: Goal: pass the Blade Trial at the end of the season.

activities.name: Rune Meditation
activities.description: Channeling power into the ward rune stones, measured in minutes.
activities.note: Goal: charge the ward runes before the full moon.

activities.name: Feast at the Tavern
activities.description: A sit-down feast at the Gilded Boar with the ranger band.

activities.name: Consult the Oracle
activities.description: Asking the Oracle of the Hollow Peak to read the omens for an upcoming quest.
activities.note: Goal: learn where the Ember Stone is hidden.

activities.name: Visit the Village Sage
activities.description: A visit to Old Maren, the Ashvale sage, to decode old runes.

activities.name: Browse the Bazaar
activities.description: Buying gear, arrows and trinkets at the Ashvale bazaar.

activities.name: Long Tavern Stay (2h+)
activities.description: Two hours or more at the tavern gathering quest rumours. Shorter visits are Tavern Visit.
activities.note: Goal: find a lead for the next bounty.

activities.name: Repair the Hideout
activities.description: The big upkeep: patch the roof, restock the larder, sort the armoury.
activities.note: Goal: keep the hideout ready before the winter storms.

activities.name: Crystal Ball Doomscroll
activities.description: Time lost staring into the crystal ball at gossip and false omens. One completion = one session.
activities.note: Each session drains 10 XP from every pillar.

activities.name: Send a Raven to the Lodge
activities.description: A raven report to the Rangers' lodge in Dunmere.
activities.note: Goal: keep the lodge informed so the next contract gets approved.

activities.name: Tavern Visit
activities.description: A shorter visit to the tavern or inn to hear the latest news.

activities.name: Ridge Hunt
activities.description: A full-day hunt on the north ridge with the ranger band.
activities.note: Goal: track down the ridge wolf pack.

activities.name: Forest Walk
activities.description: Scouting the Ashvale woods on foot with a fellow ranger, measured in minutes.

activities.name: Market Run
activities.description: A supply run to the big market square for rations and rope.

activities.name: Corner Stall
activities.description: A quick stop at the corner stall for arrows and small supplies.

activities.name: Guild Contracts
activities.description: Paid contract work from the Rangers' Guild board: tracking, escort jobs, bounty paperwork. Measured in hours.
activities.note: Goal: reach Silver rank in the Rangers' Guild. The first hour each day earns bonus XP.
activities.sop:
1. Check the guild board for new postings.
2. Pick the contract that fits today's route.
3. Hand in bounty paperwork the same day.

activities.name: Quick Stop at the Inn
activities.description: A brief stop at the inn by the gate to swap news.

activities.name: Armour Tune-up
activities.description: Taking armour to Brann's forge for new rivets, straps and dent repairs.
activities.note: Goal: be battle-ready for the Blade Trial.
activities.sop:
1. Scrub the mud and rust spots off the chest plate and bracers.
2. Drop them at Brann's forge for new rivets and straps.
3. Record any dents Brann finds in the gear ledger.

activities.name: Train the Familiar
activities.description: Scouting and message-carrying drills with Pip, the owl familiar, measured in minutes.

activities.name: Enchanting Workshop
activities.description: Hours at the workshop enchanting gear such as the compass. Separate from Guild Contracts.

activities.name: Stretching Kata
activities.description: A full ranger stretching kata to stay nimble on the trail.

activities.name: Sweep the Hideout
activities.description: Everyday tidying and sweeping of the hideout, measured in minutes. Bigger repairs are Repair the Hideout.

activities.name: Study Spellbooks
activities.description: Studying spellbooks and lore scrolls, measured in minutes.
activities.note: Goal: learn the Warding spell before the Blade Trial.
activities.sop:
1. Open the current spellbook at the marked chapter.
2. Work through the chapter and copy one new rune into the rune ledger.
3. Cast the rune once at the practice target.

activities.name: Raven to a Friend
activities.description: A raven exchange with a friend from the old ranger band.

activities.name: Visit a Party Member
activities.description: Visiting an old party member in person to plan a future quest.

logs.label: Send a Raven to the Lodge
Send a Raven to the Lodge
Send a Raven to the Lodge

journal.text: Long patrol day. The east road bridge is still out, so the escort job took twice as long. Pip spotted wolf tracks near the ridge; reporting them to the guild tomorrow.
Mill escort posted on the guild board. Taking it first, then drilling the Warding rune for the Blade Trial.
